Commentary.Commentary: What a damp squib! India thoroughly dominated the contest and made it a one-sided affair. Next up, in Semi-Final 2, New Zealand will be crossing swords against Bangladesh on Thursday at 1000 local (0800 GMT). The winner will meet India on Sunday for the coveted trophy. Do join us for all the action. Cheers!

India U19 skipper, Priyam Garg says that he is very happy to get to the final and are one step closer to their aim now. He feels that they have the best bowling attack in the tournament as their pacers bowl around 140 kph and their spinners are very consistent with their lines and lengths as well. On the combination of Jaiswal and Saxena , Garg adds that this is not the first time that they have done this and that they have been doing it for a long time now. Says their the running between the wickets is good and they complement each other. On being asked about the final, Garg says that he wants his team to focus on the same process and play the final as just another game.

Pakistan U19 skipper, Rohail Nazir is down for an interview. He says that the wicket was good but they did not put up a good total on the board. Says that at the halfway stage when Pakistan were batting, they were going good but in the middle overs the crucial partnership never came and that hurt them. Talking about the Indian team, he says that their batting is exceptional along with their bowling and fielding which is very good as well. Adds that they will learn from their mistakes. Ends by saying they have to perform in the crunch moments and is looking forward to the 3rd place playoff match.

Yashasvi Jaiswal has been named the Man of the Match for his fantastic unbeaten ton. He starts by saying that this is a dream come true for him and these feelings cannot be described in words. Says defeating Pakistan in a semi-final is extra special. On his partnership with Saxena, he says that they had to stay at the wicket because the pitch was pretty good. Mentions that they decided to ride out the tough spell and knew that it would become easier later. Adds that all this is because of the hard work done by everyone, right from the management, the physios and his teammates. Ends by thanking the crowd for coming out in large numbers and supporting them.

It was a listless performance by Pakistan at the grand stage. Their batting suffered a collapse and then their bowling failed to turn up. They will be crestfallen after losing so badly to their neighbours. The Boys in Blue complete a dominating and ruthless performance and are looking good to defend their title.

A comprehensive win for India! They have thrashed their arch-rivals in this crunch encounter and stormed into their third successive final of the ICC Under-19 World Cup! It could have been a stiff target given the bowling prowess of Pakistan but the Indian openers applied themselves and completely blunted the bowling attack. Yashasvi Jaiswal stroked a fluent century and received good support from Divyaansh Saxena from the other end. Together the pair showed great temperament and technique to outclass Pakistan.

SIX! HUNDRED FOR JAISWAL! VICTORY FOR INDIA! Smiles everywhere in the Indian camp. Flighted and full around middle, Yashasvi goes down on one knee and smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum. He raises both his arms in triumph and then jumps in joy. INDIA WIN BY 10 WICKETS!
Two wides! Ali darts one down the leg side, the keeper fumbles and they cross.
A rank full toss outside off, Saxena restrains himself and pushes it out straight to mid off.
Beaten! Nervy moment. Loopy full ball around off, Yashasvi pushes inside the line and misses.

Flatter and shorter outside off, Yashasvi slaps it through point and the fielder in the deep dives across to his right to make a half stop. It once again starts to approach the rope but the fielder recovers and picks it up before it could touch the line. Two taken, Jaiswal is on 99!
FOUR! One big shot away from a hundred now. Tossed up ball around middle, Jaiswal gives it the full whack of his bat and smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched through covers for one.
Driven off the front foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Fullish around off, it's pushed back to the right side of the bowler. Nicely stopped.
Qasim Akram comes back on for the final overs. 7-0-30-0, his figures so far.
Too full in length around off, forced down to long on for one. 12 needed more and Jaiswal is seven shy of a hundred.
Lets the ball to turn back into him and works it to the right of short fine leg for a single.
Full and flighted on middle, Divyaansh presses forward and drives it to long on for a run.
The Pakistani skipper and keeper has hurt himself. Physio makes his appearance. Rohail Nazir is limping off the ground! Mohammad Haris has donned the gloves now. 15 runs left to achieve for India.

Wide! Flatter delivery, a touch short and skidding down the leg side, Saxena tries to sweep but misses. It hits Rohail near his knee, the unprotected area behind the flap of his pad. That would have stung and he is down in pain.
Goes down on one knee for the slog sweep but misses. It takes his pads and lobs behind towards short fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Again quicker through the air, fired in full on middle, it's flicked to mid-wicket.
Quicker one, short and outside off, Yashasvi plays late but finds short third man.
Once again fails to pick the gap! Fuller in length and outside off, Divyaansh drives it off his front foot to cover-point. Maiden!
On a length and outside off, Saxena drives off the front foot but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Shortish and close to off, Saxena plays it down from the crease to point.
Very full in length around off, Divyaansh digs it out back towards the bowler.
Fuller in length and outside off, Saxena drives it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Saxena rocks back and taps it down to short third man.
Tahir Hussain is back into the attack. 5-0-17-0, his figures so far.
Flighted and full around off, Jaiswal flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Forces a full ball down to long on and takes a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Gets forward to a full ball and works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and wide outside off, Yashasvi plays a late cut wide of backward point for a brace.
Wide! A delivery angling down the leg side, Jaiswal gets down to play a paddle sweep but fails to connect. A good stop by the keeper.
Aamir Ali is back on to bowl what might be some of the final overs of the innings. 3-0-21-0, his figures so far.
On a length around off, defended back towards the bowler. 18 from the over, 22 needed more.

FOUR! Boundaries are coming thick and fast. This time it's come from the bat of Divyaansh. Good length ball around off, Saxena plays late and it hurries off the outside part of his blade to third man for a boundary. 150 comes up for India!
Slower in pace and fuller in length around off, Jaiswal pushes it to point for one.

SIX! Jaiswal has pressed on the accelerator. Poor delivery by Afridi. Attempts a slower short ball but it's down the leg side, Jaiswal turns inside the crease and launches it over long leg. The fielder in the deep is a mere spectator. Moves to 88!

SIX! Glimpses of Raina in that shot! Wow. As clean as a whistle. A length ball has been angled into the batsman, Jaiswal swings his bat across the line and dismisses it over mid-wicket. He is thinking three figures here!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Saxena taps it down to point for one.

FIFTY! A full toss on middle and off, Divyaansh drives it through extra cover for a single. Fifty up for Saxena and it has been a superb knock by him. Just like Jaiswal, it's been a fluent innings by him. He is contained in playing the supporting role in this partnership.
Fuller and on off, worked in front of square leg for a run.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then taps it behind square leg. Dot ball.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a run.
Flighted delivery, landing very full outside off, Saxena drives it down to long off and collects a run.

DRINKS! Saxena and Jaiswal have just made it look too easy out in the middle and it looks like only the formalities remain now. Jaiswal will be trying to get to a three-figure score and Saxena is happy playing second fiddle to him. Fahad Munir to continue after the break.
An overpitched delivery outside off, Jaiswal drives it delightfully through point and scampers back for the second run. 12 from the over, 45 needed more!
Fullish and outside off, driven off the front foot but straight to covers.

FOUR! Jaiswal not in control for the first time. Afridi gets some extra bounce on his shortish ball around middle and leg. Yashasvi tries to glance it off his hips but it takes the inner half and runs fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Width on offer outside off, Saxena eases it down to third man for a run.
The bowler goes short to correct his length, it's outside off and steered through point for one.

FOUR! Jaiswal follows the aerial route and finds the gap. First boundary after the 22nd over. Afridi spears in a fuller length ball around off, Jaiswal clears his front leg and nails it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Helps it with the spin to the leg side but straight to mid-wicket on this occasion.
Shortish and outside off, Saxena gets closer to the delivery and tries to late cut it past backward point. Finds the fielder instead.
This one is bowled quicker through the air. Flat and a touch short around leg, the batsman eases it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A full toss around leg, Saxena steps down the track and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Very full again, around off, it's stroked down to long off for one.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Jaiswal lunges and defends it to the off side.
Fullish and outside off, Divyaansh drives it through the line but fails to beat the diving attempt of the point fielder.
Some movement there! Probably a slower one. A cutter landing full outside off and moving in, Saxena strides forward and drives it back to the bowler from the inner part of his bat.
Back of a length ball around off, Jaiswal taps it down to backward point and steals a run. Good running between the wickets has been a regular feature of this partnership.
Angles in a good length ball around off, Yashasvi remains back in defense.
Short in length and outside off, Jaiswal takes a very early call of ducking it.
Lands it on a length around off, Saxena drops it with soft hands to covers and crosses for a brisk run. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end. Wouldn't have mattered much though.
Abbas Afridi is back on. 4-0-18-0, his figures so far.
Tossed up ball on middle, Yashasvi flicks it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket. Slow going from India but they are very much on course. 62 more needed.
Finds the fielder. Very full in length around off, Jaiswal forces his cover drive through the line but finds the fielder.
Spinning down the leg side, Jaiswal helps it behind square leg.
Around leg, it's glanced with the spin through square leg for a comfortable single.
Strides forward to a full ball and uses his wrists to work it down to long on. One more added to the total.
Flatter ball on middle, defended from the crease to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery, landing full and around leg, Jaiswal leans forward and drives it with the turn to long off for one.
Stays back to a shortish ball and strokes it towards the extra cover fielder.
Steps down the track early but still does well to punch it through mid off for a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and strokes it through covers for one.
Flatter and shorter outside off, turning away, Yashasvi punches but finds the cover fielder.
Jaiswal has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Nicely floated full ball around off, Saxena gets forward and defends it solidly. Both the batsmen have shown great technique not just in offense but in defense as well.
This delivery is very full and around off, Jaiswal drills his drive past the diving bowler for a run at long on.
Loopy and full around off, Jaiswal lunges and blocks it watchfully.
Shortish and on off, Divyaansh goes back and punches it to long off for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, defended from the back foot to the off side.
Full and flighted around off, Saxena prods forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Fahad Munir comes into the attack now.
Misfield at backward point. Flatter and shorter outside off, Yashasvi reaches out and plays the late cut. The fielder inside the ring misfields and allows a brace.
Quicker and shorter one on off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.

False shot! Such a rarity. A flatter delivery landing a bit short around off, it lands and breaks back into the batsman. Saxena moves back to punch it through the off side but it gathers the inside edge and rolls to square leg.
Tossed up ball around off, Saxena presses forward in defense.
Full and flighted around off, Jaiswal drives it through mid off for a single.
100 up for India! 73 needed more. Back of a length delivery outside off, Jaiswal stays back and guides it down to third man for a run. 11 from this over.
Serves a full ball around leg, Jaiswal clips it fine down the leg side for a run. The fielder in the deep attacks the ball, fumbles slightly and that's enough for the batsmen to steal an extra run.
Amir Khan delivers a bouncer around middle, Yashasvi ducks to evade it. Such a calm and composed batsman. Keeping his ego aside and playing on merit of the ball.

FOUR! Brings up a half century in this crunch game! Fuller length ball around middle, Jaiswal has his head over the ball and flicks it with immaculate timing through mid-wicket. Raises his bat to acknowledge his dressing room.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
FOUR! Very classy! A length ball around middle and leg, Jaiswal brings down a straight bat, his head is very still and he just lofts it over the bowler's head. Everything was beautiful in that shot.
Mohammad Amir Khan (4-1-9-0) is back on.
Saxena has played that off the front foot and into the ground. No pressure whatsoever on India.
Flatter delivery, short and close to off, Jaiswal stays back and punches it to through extra cover for one.

A slider on middle, skidding in, Yashasvi stays back and hits it in the gap at deep mid-wicket for a couple. Ian Bishop (on air) calls it a thing of beauty. He calls out that Jaiswal's off side play is exquisite but the way he used the depth of crease in this shot shows that he is in full control.
Fuller and on off, skidding in, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Full and flighted ball around off, Jaiswal lunges and defends it near his front pad.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone by Jaiswal.

FOUR! Bottom edge! Flatter delivery, a touch short outside off and staying low, Saxena moves back to play the square cut but it takes the bottom edge and goes through the legs of the keeper for a boundary. Rohail Nazir is disappointed. Nothing working for his team.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Saxena moves inside the crease and blocks.
Loopy and full, wide outside off, Yashasvi drives it through covers and looks for two. Only one available.
Quicker and flatter on middle, punched back in the direction of the bowler.
Flighted and full on middle, Jaiswal gets behind the line and defends it back with a straight bat.
Leans forward to a full ball around off and pushes it with firm hands to point.
Knocks a full ball through mid off and takes a single. Doing it with ease.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Hangs on the back foot to a short ball and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.

Gives this one a good toss in the air and lands it full around off, Jaiswal drives it back towards the bowler. Qasim goes down to stop it but fails to do so cleanly. Ends up parrying it behind to long off and the batsmen switch ends.
Tossed up ball around middle, it's been worked in the gap at mid-wicket. Good early call and the batsmen cross for a run.
Flighted full ball around leg, an off spinner, Saxena defends it back off the front foot.

Drinks! It has been a smooth sail for India in this run chase. Both their openers have looked solid in the middle, completely unfazed. Pakistan are lacking in intensity and execution of plans. So far, their bowling which has been the stronger suit for them in this tournament has looked flat. Can they bounce back? 96 more needed for a win. Qasim Akram (3-0-16-0) to bowl after the break.
On the pads, defended towards the leg side by Jaiswal. 10 runs off the over and India running away with the game.
Floated one on middle and leg, flicked towards the mid-wicket region and the batters take a couple.
Flatter one, played towards point.
On the pads of Saxena, works this one towards square leg for a single.
On the pads this time, Jaiswal flicks this one towards the leg side for a single. Brings the target below 100 runs with this.
SIX! Boom! Jaiswal lets it all go! Aamir Ali floats this one up outside off, Jaiswal gets down on one knee and slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
This time it's full and straight, Divyaansh flicks it through mid-wicket and the in-ring fielder gives the chase. The batsmen take a couple to complete the over. 106 needed more!
Fifth dot in a row! But there is no scoreboard pressure on India. Good length ball close to off, Saxena opens the face of his bat and eases it in front of gully.
Pitches it up and around off, Saxena drives it off his front foot but finds the cover fielder.

Afridi eyes a yorker this time but the execution is not proper. He ends up bowling a full toss on middle and Divyaansh pushes it down to mid on. Straight towards the fielder and Jaiswal returns in his crease as he was out in search of a run.
Back of a length ball around off, rising onto the batsman, Saxena stays back and pushes it out with a loose bottom hand to gully.
Afridi steams in from 'round the wicket, lets out a big grunt and delivers a length ball just inside the tram line. Saxena has nothing to do with it.
Floated on middle and off, pushed towards mid on for a single and Saxena retains strike.
FOUR! Floated delivery on middle and off, Saxena connects with his sweep shot unlike Jaiswal and lofts it towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, pushed towards the man at mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Loud appeal but turned down! Floated delivery outside off, Jaiswal looks to go down on one knee and sweep fine down the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The Pakistan players appeal but the umpire turns it down. Maybe the ball was going down the leg side. The ball rolls down towards fine leg and the batters take a leg bye.
Floated on middle and off, pushed towards mid on and the batters take a single.
Aamir Ali is into the attack now. A slip is present for him.
Full ball on off, Jaiswal drives it towards the man at cover. He goes for a direct hit but the batters haven't even thought about taking a run. Frustration showing here!
Afridi corrects his line, but again Jaiswal shuffles and this time flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple. Mature cricket from the youngster.
Wide! Way wide outside off now, Jaiswal leaves that one alone. Yashasvi messing with the mind of Afridi here.
Length ball on the off pole line by Abbas, Jaiswal shuffles across and takes it on the hips. He flicks this one towards backward square leg for a couple. Clever cricket by Jaiswal.
Deep square leg moves out to strengthen the off side field.
Length ball just outside off, guided down towards the fielder at third man.
Around off on a good length, it's stroked off the back foot to covers.

EDGED! JUST SHORT! Good length delivery around off, Saxena pushes inside the line with an angled bat and it goes behind off the outer half. The ball drops in front of the wide first slip fielder. Could have put in a dive.
Another cover drive but this time straight to the man at cover.
FOUR! Exquisite! After numerous superb cover drives, Jaiswal finally pierces the gap and bags a boundary. He looks flawless while playing that shot. 50 comes up for India with this stroke.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards cover.

Appeal for a caught behind but nothing doing! Flatter delivery just outside off, Jaiswal rocks back and looks to cut but fails to do so. The Pakistan players put in a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Floated on off, pushed towards the man at covers.
FOUR! Driven away! Floated delivery on middle and leg, Jaiswal drives this one down the ground through mid on for a boundary.
Full delivery around off, defended by Divyaansh.

FOUR! Great timing and equally great placement. Length ball outside off, Saxena goes back and punches this one through point. The fielder from third man runs across to his right, puts in a dive but the ball crosses the fence.
Yorker outside off, Saxena does well to jam this one out towards the off side.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot by Saxena.
Length ball just outside off, Saxena looks to have a poke at this one but misses.
Good length ball on middle and off, Saxena plays this one right back towards the bowler.
Flatter one on off, Jaiswal rocks back and defends this one out.
Floated on off, this time Saxena pierces the gap at covers and gets a single.
Flatter one this time, Saxena rocks back and defends.
Loopy delivery on off again, driven towards the man at mid off.
Tossed up outside off, Saxena plays this one a touch uppishly towards point. A good diving stop there by Huraira.
Floated on off, driven down to mid off.
Qasim Akram is back on after his solitary over in which he conceded 7 runs.
Length ball on middle and off, defended by Jaiswal towards the off side.
Length ball outside off, Saxena guides this one down to third man for a single.
Superb drive but straight to the man! Full ball on off, Saxena drives this one towards the man at cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length ball on middle, Saxena defends it out.
Wide! Way outside off, Saxena leaves it alone.

EDGED AND FOUR! Lucky break for Saxena! Full ball on off, Saxena again looks to go for the expansive cover drive but this time the ball goes off the outside edge past the man at first slip and into the third man fence.
Abbas Afridi into the attack now.
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. If the match lasts till then...
Length ball outside off, Saxena plays this one towards point and takes a single to end Powerplay 1. India 33/0 after 10 overs.
Good length ball on middle and off, the ball pitches and seams away. Saxena looks to play at it but misses.
Good length ball on middle and off, Saxena prods forward and defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot! Saxena has held that pose for the photographers and it is an exquisite stroke. Full ball on off, Saxena drives this one through the cover-point region and bags a boundary.
Length ball close to the body, Saxena drops his gloves and lets that one through.
Good length ball just outside off, Saxena defends it out.
Full ball on off, superbly driven towards cover but straight to the man there. That shot deserved some runs at least.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side.
Good length ball on middle and off, Jaiswal plays this one back towards the bowler.
Good length ball on off, played towards the off side.

Length ball on off, Jaiswal plays this one beautifully towards cover-point but the fielder there this time dives to his left and makes a brilliant stop. The batters take a single though. Saved three runs for his side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball on middle, Saxena gets on top of it and defends.
Saxena again plays this one towards point but straight to the man.
This time Saxena connects with a similar ball but the man at point does well as he dives to his right and saves at least a couple of runs for his side.
Length delivery just outside off, Saxena stands tall and looks to play at it but does so inside the line and the ball whizzes past his blade.
Length ball way outside off, Saxena leaves this one alone.
Length ball on off, played towards the man at point.
Wide! Way outside off, Saxena goes chasing after it but misses.
On the pads, flicked straight towards the man at mid-wicket.

Good fielding in the deep! Length ball on middle and leg, Jaiswal stands tall and pulls this one behind square leg. Mohammad Amir Khan runs to his right and makes a good diving stop. Two runs taken by Jaiswal.
Full and on the pads of Saxena, he flicked this one towards the leg side and takes a single. Exactly 150 more needed for India to win.
Back of a length ball on middle, Saxena rocks back and defends.
Full ball on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket by Saxena and the batters take a couple. Easy pickings!
Hussain starts the over with a full ball on off, driven towards the man at mid off.
Full ball on middle and off, Yashasvi does well to play this one towards the man at mid off.
Another full ball on off, driven towards the man at cover again by Jaiswal.
Well struck but straight to the man! Back of a length ball outside off, Jaiswal stands tall and cuts this one but it rolls to the man at point.
Full ball on off, driven towards the man at cover now.
Good length ball on the pads, worked towards the man at square leg by Jaiswal.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Fuller in length and close to off, Saxena pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Nicely eased away! A delivery on the pads of the left-hander, Saxena flicks it through square leg and collects a couple of runs.
Straight to the cover fielder. Fullish and around off, it's driven off the front foot but not in the gap.
A length ball on middle and angling in, Jaiswal clips it off his pads behind square leg and takes a run.
On a length and in the zone outside off, holding its line, Yashasvi covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Jaiswal allows it through to the keeper.
Pitches it up and around off, it's driven to the right of mid off for a brisk run.

Beaten comprehensively! Beautifully bowled by Khan. He delivers it on a length around leg and seams away considerably after hitting the deck. Jaiswal is squared up completely in defense as the ball beats the outside edge. The bowler gives a stare!
Huge grunt from Amir as he bends his back and delivers a short ball on middle and off. Jaiswal crouches and leans away to evade it.
Back of a length ball around off, Saxena stays back and runs it down to third man for a run.
A bit short and on off, it's punched from the back foot but straight to covers.
Beaten this time! A length ball around off, Saxena tries defending from the crease but the angle of the bowler takes it away and beats the outside edge.
Wide! False start. Amir starts with a length delivery way wide outside off, outside the tram line too, Saxena allows it through to the keeper.
So, it was just one over of experiment with spin. Mohammad Amir Khan has been given the ball and a couple of slip fielders along with it.
Too full in length around off, Yashasvi drives it confidently but finds the mid off fielder.
Digs in a short ball around middle and leg, coming slowly off the surface, Jaiswal is early into the pull shot and it takes the inner half of his blade. It rolls safely in front of square leg.
Lovely shot! Fullish delivery outside off, Saxena leans into the drive and strokes it through point for a single.
A little bit of width provided outside off, Yashasvi stays back and steers it behind backward point for a run.
One of the two slip fielders moves out and goes to short mid-wicket.
Good length ball close to off, angling in, Jaiswal solidly gets behind the line in defense.
Fuller in length and around off, Jaiswal drives but picks out the cover fielder.
Loopy and full around off, the batsman draws forward and drives it down to long off for a run.
Hangs on the back foot to a shortish ball and punches it to covers.
Quicker one, flat and around leg, easily turned in the gap at square leg for one.
Tossed up ball on middle, Yashasvi helps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! First boundary of the run chase! Qasim fires in a flatter delivery on middle, Jaiswal uses the crease nicely, goes back and works it with good timing through mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot by Jaiswal.
Spin from the other end. Qasim Akram to roll his arm. A slip is in place...
Outside off, on a length, tapped down to point.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Wide! Once again Tahir drifts down the leg side, Yashasvi tries to flick but misses.

Out comes Jaiswal's favourite cover drive. He finds the line and length to be apt for that shot and strokes it through extra cover. Haris makes a partial stop inside the ring and it slows up on its way behind. The batsmen pick a couple.
Angling into the batsman, around middle and leg, Yashasvi works it on the leg side but finds the fielder standing in front of square leg.
Wide! With nothing happening off the surface, Hussain tries to angle in a length ball into the batsman. But he gets his line all wrong and ends up slipping it way down the leg side.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Jaiswal once again covers his stumps and shoulders arms. No movement so far for the Pakistan speedster.
Starts with a fuller length delivery outside off, Jaiswal takes his front leg forward and then makes a leave.

We're back for the run chase. Dark clouds have started to gather to just add to the drama. Yashasvi Jaiswal and Divyaansh Saxena are the Indian openers. They have a below-par target in front and can take their time to settle down. Pakistan's real strength has been bowling in this tournament and they would be banking on some early wickets to have a shout in this match. Who will succeed? Powerplay 1 would throw a clear picture our way. Tahir Hussain to speed in with the first new ball...
